verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a dedicated 'fast, read-only agent for exploring codebases' and a plan agent for analyzing code without modifying it. It also automatically loads LSPs for the LLM, and a community user independently praises that LSP integration. Together these directly support understanding a codebase before making changes. Missing for 10: in-depth docs showing how exploration surfaces architecture or points to where changes should start, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the explore/plan agents' effectiveness for codebase understanding.
